note: Model-string to pricing-catalog matching, asserted identically by the server and the dashboard.
The server matches in src/services/pricingCatalog.service.ts; the dashboard fetches the catalog
once and matches locally in web/src/lib/catalog.ts. Two implementations of one rule drift, and
the drift is invisible: the editor would auto-fill a price the gateway would never have chosen.
Both suites run `cases` against `catalog` below. This file is the contract: an implementation
that stops satisfying it fails on its own side, and changing the rule means editing these
cases, which immediately fails the other side until it agrees.
The server suite additionally asserts every entry in `catalog` still
exists in the real src/data/pricingCatalog.ts with the same provider, so this snapshot cannot
quietly go stale and start certifying a rule against models that no longer ship.
`expect` is the `match` field of the entry that should win, or null for no match.

cases.why: longest prefix wins, so mini never falls through to the base model
a dated variant inherits its base entry
OpenRouter namespaces by vendor: matching only from position 0 missed all 400 of its models
OpenRouter writes dots where the catalog writes dashes
dot-folding plus a dated suffix, namespaced
Hugging Face namespaces too, and has no catalog entry: stays honestly unpriced
a prefix may not stop in the middle of a token
with a provider, a same-provider entry is a clean hit
a Google alias id that only the alias entry covers
gpt-4o via OpenRouter is NOT priced like gpt-4o from OpenAI: matched, but flagged
a provider with no entry at all still gets a flagged fallback
